lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr6Ga6Ni4 (reduced formula Zr3Ga3Ni2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all three elements adopt a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with 8 geometric neighbors per center atom: Ga and Ni are each surrounded by 4 Ga and 4 Zr neighbors, while Zr has 4 Ga and 4 Ni neighbors, all at 2.8542 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner, edge, and face sharing among the 8-vertex coordination polyhedra of Ga and Ni centers, and corner and face sharing between Ga and Zr polyhedra.
